name: Visual Snow Simulator
summary:
Decode Your Vision. Quantify Your Data in Immersive VR.

Subjective visual noise is difficult to explain. Visual Snow Simulator VR lets you visually recreate your sensory symptoms—directly in your physical surroundings via Passthrough, or in immersive virtual worlds. Designed for individuals with Visual Snow Syndrome (VSS), this tool bridges the gap between subjective experience and structured clinical data.
